The payoff was a second ability triggered on ON_BANISH, which is not a trigger name -- dispatch falls back to the raw string and matches nothing, so it never ran. 'Whenever THIS banishes' means the banish this card just did, so it is a CONDITIONAL in the SAME ability, reading the `banished` ref BANISH now records. No new engine event needed. 'Another card with the same NAME' was written as REF_PITCH_IS pitch:1. Pitch 1 is red; it has nothing to do with names.

Its target named the zone under a `type` key -- {"type":"TOP_DECK","controller":"opponent"} -- a fifth spelling. That dict IS accepted as a canonical target (it has `controller`) but carries no `zone`, so it fell through to the ARENA default: a card saying "banish the top card of THEIR DECK" banished from their arena instead. The compiler now reads a zone named that way, and the card says `zone` outright.
